prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: Otterly.AI is a good place to start
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **Otterly.AI is a good place to start**: it tracks whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and several other AI search services, and its entry plan is relatively affordable—about **$29/month** for 15 tracked prompts, with a free trial listed.

Set up prompts that sound like real customer questions, such as “best [your service] in [your town]” or “who can help with [customer problem] near me.” Check the results over time, since AI answers can vary by wording and date. A tracker measures visibility; it can’t guarantee that an AI will recommend you.

If you only need an occasional check, you can also try those questions directly in ChatGPT and other AI services, but the answers may vary and won’t give you consistent tracking. Pricing and plan details can change, so confirm them on Otterly’s site before subscribing.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
